decision_rule.fail: Any gate failure leaves G3 ungraduated and G3:R0 locked.
decision_rule.pass: After exact cold replay certification, emit G3_GRADUATED_CAPS7_RECURSIVE_RELATION_GRAMMAR_EARNED_R0_UNLOCKED.
decision_rule.primary_run: Primary S6 PASS produces only a G3 graduation candidate.

fresh_holdout.reservation_check: For every exact final relation in every holdout case, check every enabled endpoint type and require the complete exact successor relation to be nonempty and uniformly CAPS7=f-e_t.

frozen_grammar.compose: C_ab(f,g)=f+g-e_a-e_b iff (a,b) is in the frozen operator basis and f_a>0 and g_b>0
frozen_grammar.relation_level_semantics: Complete relation operations enumerate every exact branch/branch pair and exact-deduplicate only after branch generation.

observer.name: G3_TRANSITION_GRAMMAR_CAPS7_OBSERVER_V1
reads: external reservation enabledness by endpoint type

question: Does the earned G3 CAPS7 read/write quotient remain exact under arbitrary finite recursive use of the frozen complete-relation reservation/binary grammar, with fresh exact pair+pair/deep/rebracketing holdout transfer and no hidden selector reads, so that G3 may graduate under the frozen CAPS7 transition observer?

recursive_proof_obligation.base: Every graduated G2 unit is a legal G3 leaf with inherited CAPS7.
recursive_proof_obligation.binary_step: Uniform-CAPS7 complete relations remain uniform after complete relation-valued binary composition with q=f+g-e_a-e_b.
recursive_proof_obligation.closure: All abstract successors remain in N^7.
recursive_proof_obligation.context_consequence: CAPS7 equality is preserved through every finite admitted G3 context; exact branch multiplicity/topology may differ.
recursive_proof_obligation.dedupe_step: Exact deduplication cannot change the singleton CAPS7 image.
recursive_proof_obligation.reserve_step: Uniform-CAPS7 complete relations remain uniform after complete relation-valued reserve with q=f-e_t.
